Central Administrative 
Communications 
Department of MLSD 
Issue No.: 3249/1/14 
Date: 09/03/ 1438 H. 
Attachment Type: N/A

An unofficial English translation. This document shall be construed in Arabic and 
English; in the event of any inconsistency between the Arabic and English versions, the 
Arabic version shall prevail. 
 Ministerial Decision No. (3249) dated 09/ 03/ 1438 H.
Minister of Labor and Social Development,

Having reviewed Articles (11bis, 28 & 243) of the Labor Law issued under 
Royal Decree No. (M/51) dated 23/ 08/ 1426 H, amended under Royal 
Decree No. (M/46) dated 05/ 06/ 1436 H, reviewed the Disability Law 
issued under Royal Decree No. (M/37) dated 23/ 09/1421 H, reviewed 
Article (10) of the Implementing Regulations of Labor Law issued under 
Royal Decree No. (1982) dated 28/ 06/ 1437 H encompassing the 
definition of Disability and Work, and reviewed Ministerial Decision No. 
(1/1/4624/A) dated 21/ 10/ 1433 H encompassing the calculation of 
persons with disabilities within the program for incentivizing firms to 
localization (Nitaqat), based on the authorities dully granted to him; 
 Decides as follows: 
First: Macro and large firms shall obtain a certificate for creating an 
enabling work environment for persons with disabilities from the 
authority(s) adopted by the Ministry and published on the Ministry's 
website. This certificate indicates that tasks and nature of the job 
occupied by the person with disability correspond to the type and 
degree of his/ her disability and that the requirements of work 
environment and offering the relevant facilitating services are met, in 
accordance with the Guide attached to the Implementing Regulations 
of Labor Law. 
Second: In case pf a failure by the macro and large firms to obtain the 
certificate specified in clause (First) to be submitted to the Ministry no 
later than 01/ 04/ 1439 H, the percentage established for calculating a 
worker with disability in the Program for incentivizing firms to 
localization (Nitaqat) shall be reduced to (2) ordinary workers. One year 
later, the percentage dedicated for calculating the worker with 
disability shall be reduced to only one worker.

Central Administrative 
Communications 
Department of MLSD 
Issue No.: 3249/1/14 
Date: 09/03/ 1438 H. 
Attachment Type: N/A

An unofficial English translation. This document shall be construed in Arabic and 
English; in the event of any inconsistency between the Arabic and English versions, the 
Arabic version shall prevail. 
Third: This decision shall repeal all its previous decisions that are not in 
conformity with the provisions herein and those included in "Nitaqat" 
Program document. 
Fourth: This decision shall enter into force after the date of issuance 
thereof and be published in the Official Gazette and on the Ministry's 
website. 
Fifth: The Vice Minister takes the necessary action for implementation 
thereof.

Minister of Labor and Social Development, 
Ali bin Nasser Al-Ghafis 
(Signed)
